title: De-Slick Oil-Control Makeup Setting Spray
description_html:
A featherlight finishing mist designed with oily skin in mind. It helps keep shine in check and holds makeup in place, so the complexion stays fresh and matte from morning to evening. This is the travel size, easy to keep in a bag for midday touch-ups.

  • Shade: Sheer
  • Finish: Matte
  • Size: 1.0 fl oz (30 ml), travel size
key_benefits: Helps control oil and surface shine through the day
Keeps makeup looking fresh and in place
Travel size suits a bag or carry-on

title: No. 5 Fine Bond Maintenance Conditioner
description_html:
A light volumizing conditioner made specifically for fine hair. It pairs bond-building technology with low molecular weight hyaluronic acid and flexible polymers, so strands feel hydrated, smooth and easy to detangle while keeping their lift and body. It is designed to follow No. 4FINE Bond Maintenance Volumizing Shampoo.

  • Hair type: Fine hair, straight to coily, all porosity levels
  • Size: 8.5 fl oz (250 ml)
  • Formula: Vegan, color-safe and suitable for chemically treated hair; free of sulfates, silicones, phthalates, phosphates, parabens and protein
key_benefits: Adds body and lift without weighing fine hair down
Weightless hydration that leaves hair soft and smooth
Makes detangling noticeably easier
how_to_use: After shampooing, work a small amount through clean, wet hair from mid-lengths to ends. Leave on for one to three minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

title: Soft Pop Plumping Blush Veil
description_html:
A sheer cream blush balm with hyaluronic acid that hydrates and gives cheeks a soft, plumped look. The weightless formula grips the skin and leaves a luminous wash of color, easy to wear lightly for a no-makeup look or to build up for more definition.

  • Shade: Just Peachy (peachy coral)
  • Finish: Luminous
  • Size: 0.17 oz (5 g)
  • Formula: Vegan and cruelty-free
key_benefits: Sheer, buildable cream color with a luminous finish
Hyaluronic acid helps cheeks look hydrated and plump
Weightless balm texture that blends with fingers or brush
how_to_use: Swirl a brush or fingertips through the balm and press onto the apples of the cheeks, blending up toward the temples. Wear it over your usual base, or layer it over setting powder for a luminous last step.

title: AstroLift Reparative Volume Spray Mini
description_html:
The travel-size edition of K18's light, buildable volume spray. Made with K18PEPTIDE and a hair-fiber thickening blend, it addresses the damage that leaves hair flat and gives soft, touchable body that can last up to two days. It works on dry or towel-dried hair, with or without heat styling.

  • Hair type: All hair types, especially fine or fragile hair
  • Size: 1.6 fl oz (47 ml), mini
key_benefits: Flexible, touchable volume that can last up to two days
Non-sticky, buildable texture for dry or towel-dried hair
Helps hold volume in humid weather
how_to_use: Shake well and hold the bottle four to six inches from the hair. Spray generously through the roots and lengths of dry or towel-dried hair, then blow-dry for extra lift if you like.

A dry texturizing spray for fine hair that tends to fall flat. It builds lift, airy texture and fullness in moments and refreshes second- and third-day hair, with zeolite to absorb excess oil at the roots. The spray was named Best Pro Texturizing Spray by Glamour in 2021.

  • Hair type: Fine, flat hair
  • Scent: Citrus with watery green notes and warm woods
  • Size: 5.5 oz
  • Formula: Vegan and cruelty-free; free of sulfates, silicones, parabens, phthalates and gluten
key_benefits: Instant lift and airy texture for fine hair

title: Soft Pinch Matte Bouncy Blush
description_html:
A springy, putty-like blush that melts in like a cream and settles into a soft-focus powder finish. Color builds easily from a gentle flush to something brighter, and the matte result stays put without creasing or drying skin. Cacao seed and pomegranate, papaya seed and rose hip oils help keep skin comfortable.

  • Shade: Happy (cool pink)
  • Finish: Matte
  • Size: 0.22 oz (6.4 g)
key_benefits: Cream-to-powder texture with a soft, blurred matte finish
Buildable color that resists sweat, water and humidity
Does not settle into creases or emphasize texture
how_to_use: Tap onto the cheeks with fingertips or a blush brush and build to the intensity you like. It goes on most smoothly over moisturized, well-prepped skin.

description_html:
A silky powder blush that brings soft color and a lit-from-within glow to every skin tone. It combines the flush of Soft Pinch Liquid Blush with the radiance of a highlighter, blending evenly with no chalky or ashy cast. Each pan is hand-polished.

  • Shade: Cheer (light warm pink)
  • Finish: Luminous
  • Size: 0.098 oz (2.8 g)

title: All of the Above Weightless Eyeshadow Stick
description_html:
A creamy, multi-use eyeshadow stick that lines, shades, smokes out and highlights in a single step. The weightless gel color blends easily and is filled with fine pearls for dimension, then sets to a crease-resistant finish. A sharpener is built into the base.

  • Shade: Integrity (champagne)
  • Size: 0.04 oz (1.3 g)
  • Packaging: Twist-up stick with built-in sharpener
key_benefits: One stick for liner, all-over shadow and highlight
Smooth, weightless color with fine shimmer
Water-resistant, crease-resistant wear
how_to_use: Twist up and swipe across the lid, then blend with a fingertip or brush. Glide the tip along the lash line to use it as a liner, or tap a little on the inner corners to highlight.

title: Positive Light Under Eye Brightener
description_html:
A light, fluid brightener that wakes up the under-eye area and softens the look of shadows. The creamy formula blends easily and builds from sheer to medium coverage, so it can be worn alone or over concealer. A cool-tip metal applicator makes application feel refreshing.

  • Shade: Light (neutral undertones for fair to light skin)
  • Size: 0.13 fl oz (4 ml)
  • Packaging: Cool-tip metal applicator
key_benefits: Brightens the look of tired under-eyes
Sheer to medium, buildable coverage

how_to_use: Dot two to four points under the eye with the applicator, then tap to blend with a fingertip or brush. Wear it on bare skin or layer it over concealer, building as needed.

title: Guava Vitamin C Brightening Toner Pads
description_html:
Thin, contoured toner pads inspired by Korean multi-masking. Five forms of vitamin C with glutathione and guava help brighten the look of dark circles and dark spots, while niacinamide and caffeine help skin look less puffy. The pads are shaped to sit under the eyes or on the cheeks.

  • Concern: Dark circles, dullness and dark spots
  • Size: 60 pads (115 g)
  • Formula: Fragrance-free, alcohol-free, vegan and cruelty-free; dermatologist and ophthalmologist tested
key_benefits: Brightens the look of dark circles and dark spots
Helps under-eyes look less puffy
Contoured pads stay in place under the eyes
how_to_use: After cleansing, place a pad under the eyes or on areas of concern and leave on for five minutes, or up to fifteen for an extra boost. Remove and follow with serum and moisturizer; those with sensitive skin can start two to three times a week.
